name: Axie Duel
description: A free-to-play tactical TCG where your Axie NFTs become Yu-Gi-Oh-style battle cards. Play instantly in the browser with no wallet required to start, take on a story campaign set in Lunacia, duel in PvE and PvP, and collect on-chain Spell and Trap card NFTs on Ronin. Fan-made and not affiliated with Sky Mavis.

websites.description: Play Axie Duel free in your browser - no install, no wallet needed to try. Turn your Axies into battle cards and duel through a Lunacia campaign, PvE and PvP.

contracts.label: Axie Duel Cards
contracts.description: ERC-721 collection of in-game Spell and Trap cards (burnable), minted on Ronin for Axie Duel.
